subject: map screen renderer, observed on the owner's device
device: SM-A5360 (a53x), Android 16 / SDK 36, 1080x2400 @ 450 dpi, ARM Mali-G68, OpenGL ES 3.2
steps_performed: passive launch of the app's root activity (no account action)
one tap to dismiss the first-run survey sheet
one tap on the destination field (opens the trip-planning screen with a map)
one tap on 'set location on the map' (opens the full-screen pickup map)
not_performed: no ride requested, no payment, no profile change, no login
no interception of traffic, no live service contacted by the study

interpretation.result: the map screens in this session are rendered by the Google Play services Maps client
interpretation.contrast: the shipped parameter default in assets/parameters.json is {"initialMapProvider":"uber","fallbackMapProviders":["google"],"missingProviderDefault":"uber"}
interpretation.why_they_differ: not determined: a server-delivered parameter override at launch, a fallback-path activation, or a Google provider supplied to the Compose map path would each produce this; distinguishing them needs deeper runtime inspection, which is outside this study's boundary

limitations: single device, single session, single map flow
thread names are the process's own naming, not proof of which view class is mounted
no library-load listing is available without root; the negative evidence for the own engine is the absence of its thread families plus the on-screen Google attribution
